notes.title: Dance Club
notes.content: We have added a dance club that you can visit at any time during the game. Sit back and watch your favorite woman shake her thing. Change the music to your liking. Enjoy the emission filled atmosphere and the sexy moves.

notes.title: Back room event
notes.content: 24 Dresses, 48 lingerie added. Enter the back room of the Store while shopping on a date with your babe. New secrets to uncover. Have a good time with your date while buying new cloths. A total of 72 new clothing items to discover.

notes.title: UI and Postprocessing Update
notes.content: UI in the picture bool, store, and others have been updated to a better look. Bloom postprocessing has been added to some scenes for better looking game.

notes.title: The Change Room
notes.content: Princess boutique has opened close to Bal. Now you can take your girl on a date and buy her clothes. 24 Different patterns to choose from. Long dresses and sun dresses. Quickly gain favour by spending a little coin.

notes.title: Punch Club
notes.content:
Punch club is a new VR boxing experience. Fight the men of Bal to gain money to buy gifts for your girl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870306/bb371372ce9ccf5f3e001e9259970b76edd5c5d7.png[/img]

notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.content: Achievements are finally here. Win the woman's affections and receive an achievement as a extra reward.

notes.title: Game Release
notes.content:
I am excited to announce, after much anticipation the game is finally released. Issues with realism have been addressed. I will be adding Steam Achievements in the next update. Thank you to all who support my work. I hope you enjoy playing the game as much as I did making it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870306/3004f23bb7c6abbba9ad9a72d131e20269dad164.png[/img]

notes.title: Release update
notes.content:
Unfortunately steam is delaying the release of this game due to a realism in the game. I have had to update the game to address this issue then re-submit. I apologize for any delays. The game should be ready soon.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870306/3004f23bb7c6abbba9ad9a72d131e20269dad164.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date
notes.content: The release date is pending steam build testing. We hope to have the game released by the end of the month.
